title: Another Au32 gold fullerene: a novel spherical cage cluster with octahedral symmetry
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17470-17479
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09961G, Paper

Jiayu Li, Silei Wang, Jing Tian, Xiaoxia Yang, Xiaxi Lei, Lengzhang Xu, Wenwu Xu, Xiao Gu
The Oh-Au32 cluster is consists of a co-dual structure with truncated octahedron and cube. The hollow cage features a large HOMO–LUMO gap and spherical aromaticity.
